name: Craft Link Repair
changes: When the settings refuse a Pro choice, for example in Repair new exports (Pro), the keyboard focus now stays on that setting.
In a text field the focus leaves the field, as before.
tip: Inline day:// links become links to date notes. The repair does not create those notes, so create them after the pass.
thanks: Hi, I am Michael, a solo developer in Poland. Craft Link Repair is one of over 100 small plugins that I make. Thank you for using it to keep your links working.
